method.section: Exact primitives of the circular chord times the Fig. 21 plateau/parabola; discrete steel with displaced concrete. Root at fixed compression then solve signed axes and demand direction with angular refinement 32 to 64.
method.axes: Top-left coordinates, first bar at the specified clockwise angle from the right. Mx positive compresses top; My positive compresses left.
method.helix: Core area to outside diameter; physical centreline length per pitch; transverse fy capped at 415; check anchorage at both ends. 1.05 only for the admitted Cl. 39.3 short axial branch. Ordinary spiral without enhancement uses ordinary pitch limit.
method.axial: For zero supplied moments and admissible minimum eccentricity use Cl. 39.3 capacity. Otherwise check net-area Puz, Cl. 39.6, direct ray and separate minimum eccentricities.
